thread:
eli: Quick sync — I'm going to split the large content reflow PR into three smaller PRs so the preview build completes. Need reviewers and a merge order.

lina: Nice. Can you list the three pieces? also any i18n/backport impact?

eli: Short breakdown: PR A = nav reflow (move TOC entries, reorder), PR B = content shards (split long pages into atomic files + update anchors), PR C = redirect map + translation backports. i18n: translators will need the redirect map before we fold branches.

kevin: I'll take PR A (nav) — can review after lunch. ETA for that?

eli: Aiming to open PR A tonight, request review in the morning. PR B depends on nav being live in preview to validate anchors. PR C is last.

docs-bot: preview: build queued for PR A — https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/12345 (will update status) :gear:

marta: Heads up, PR B hit a link-check failure in local run — broken TOC anchor for the API auth section. Two failing checks in preview: link-check + build. Might be due to header slug change.

eli: repro command I used: 
```
# run locally
yarn docs:build && yarn link-check ./public
```
Quick fix is to either restore the old anchor or update the sidebar reference to `#api-authentication`. I prefer updating the anchor so it's more consistent.

sam: Can we delay PR C (redirects) until translations confirm backport windows? Translators need a stable mapping.

lina: I'm OK with PR A and B merging in order if we add a tiny integration job for anchor/link stability on PR previews. Otherwise we risk flip-flopping anchors across shards.

kevin: Agree. I'll add a link-check step to CI (small script) and push to a small branch that the other PRs can include.

docs-bot: preview: PR A build succeeded — https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/12345 — nav changes visible.

marta: Re-checking PR B with updated anchors now. If green, we can merge A then B, then C.

eli: Merge order plan: 1) PR A (nav) — reviewers @kevin + @lina, 2) PR B (content shards/anchors) — reviewers @marta + @lina, 3) PR C (redirects + i18n backports) — reviewers @sam + @eli. Gate merges on green preview for each PR. I'll tag everyone and ping translations. Thanks :thumbsup:
